title: Elliptic Chern Characters and Elliptic Atiyah--Witten Formula
summary: Let $G$ be a compact, connected, and simply connected Lie group. A principal $G$-bundle over a manifold $X$, equipped with a connection, together with a positive-energy representation of the loop group $LG$, gives rise to a circle-equivariant gerbe module on the free loop space $LX$. From this data we construct the elliptic Chern character on $LX$, and a refinement, the elliptic Bismut--Chern character, on the double loop space $L^2X$.
